blocks.text: A triglycerides test measures the amount of triglycerides in a sample of blood. Triglycerides are a type of fat in the blood.
A triglycerides test is usually part of a lipid panel, which also measures cholesterol.
A provider may use a lipid panel to help assess the risk of heart disease.

title: Triglycerides Test
